description: Free word-by-word comparison of approved lyrics and a transcript of the matching sung or spoken excerpt, supplied by a reviewer or a transcription tool. Reports changed, omitted and extra words. Ignores punctuation and case but preserves accents; Japanese and other languages use word segmentation. This tool does not transcribe or hear audio, check lip sync or judge singing quality. Transcription of singing can be wrong; listen to differences and mark transcriptVerified only if independently checked. Empty transcripts are inconclusive. Do not use whole-song lyrics against a short excerpt.
name: compare_lyrics_transcript
title: Compare approved lyrics with a supplied transcript
